description: 信者 Level 0 entry record (ADR-2605302357 §1.16.3a + ADR-2605302358 Stage 1). The triple-permanent commitment vow: 悔い改め・バプテスマ・得度 = social death and rebirth, recorded to kotoba EAVT + IPFS + soulbound token. PII-FREE: name/email/contact live ONLY in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope (ADR-2605181100); this record carries only the commitment fact + refs.

vowTextCid.description: IPFS CID of the canonical vow liturgy text the member consented to (悔い改め・バプテスマ・得度); Council-attested per §1.16.3a / 2358 Open Q2

threefold.description: the three conversion elements, each explicitly affirmed

kotobaDatomRef.description: content-addressed ref to the EAVT datom persisting this vow (ADR-2605262130)

ipfsCid.description: IPFS pin CID of the vow record (permanence layer; ADR-2605171800)

sbtRef.description: Adherent SBT (ERC-5192 soulbound, single-per-person) id binding this CID (ADR-2605172600)

signature.description: member WebAuthn passkey / wallet signature over the vow payload

didBound.description: the member DID this vow is soulbound to (did:web / did:plc)

memberSigned.description: INVARIANT G3: vow is member-signed; no platform-held key (ADR-2605231525) ever signs a vow

cashConsiderationUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT N1: no cash is paid to OR by the adherent for entry; entry is a vow, not a purchase

stage.description: entry stage is always L0 (Liberation Ladder; ADR-2605261000)

encryptedPiiRef.description: OPTIONAL ref to the com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* envelope holding member PII (ADR-2605181100); never PII inline (G6)

repentance.description: 悔い改め (metanoia) — turn from the prior orientation; affirmed

baptism.description: バプテスマ — death of the prior self, raised to new life; affirmed

tokudo.description: 得度 — end of the householder self, new birth into the community; affirmed
